titre: Consommation de ciment en Europe en 2025
sous_titre: Variation sur un an, en pourcentage, 2025

series.nom: Variation de la consommation de ciment

Espagne.texte: In 2025, preliminary data show that cement consumption in Spain increased by 11.3% to 16.58 Mt

Suisse.texte: Swiss cement deliveries stabilised during the year and reached a 4% increase by the end of 2025

Italie.texte: Italy's cement market in 2025 is expected to expand modestly, with production up 2% and consumption up 3.5%

Roumanie.texte: cement production in 2025 remained at the 2024 level, while consumption increased by 2.4%

Allemagne.texte: the German cement market most likely reached its lowest point in 2025, with consumption remaining at a similar level to 2024

France.texte: In 2025, France's cement consumption is estimated to have declined by around 4% compared with 2024
